fields.name: videoId
fields.label: Video ID
fields.description: The 11-character id from the video URL, e.g. SJtuU_6mags

fields.name: title
fields.label: Title
fields.description: Describes the video to screen readers, and captions it. Required: two untitled embeds are indistinguishable to anyone not seeing the page.

fields.name: seoTitle
fields.label: Meta Title (SEO)
fields.description: Browser tab and search results only — not shown on the page. To change the visible heading, use Page Heading below, or the Hero block's Name.

fields.name: heading
fields.label: Page Heading
fields.description: Overrides Meta Title as the visible <h1> at the top of the page. Leave blank to use Meta Title. Ignored entirely when the page starts with a Hero block, which supplies its own heading.

fields.name: alt
fields.label: Avatar Alt Text
fields.description: What a screen reader says in place of the image. Leave blank when the image is a portrait of the person in Name above — the name is already read out, so alt text repeats it. Fill it in when this Hero has no Name, or when the image is a logo, a screenshot, or anything else that means something on its own.

fields.name: limit
fields.label: Posts in grid
fields.description: Excludes the lead post shown above the grid.

fields.name: heading
fields.label: Heading
fields.description: The <h2> above the stats cards — a section heading inside this block, not the page's main heading. Leave blank to show the cards with no heading.

description.value: References another document, used as a foreign key
